name: sonner
behavior: APG alert/status host — the notification region, not the notification. An aria-live region (polite for tone info/success, assertive for warning/critical) that is never focusable and never moves focus; toasts are appended to it and announced in place; pointer hover or keyboard focus anywhere inside pauses every auto-dismiss timer in the region; each toast's own dismiss and action controls stay in the normal Tab order so a keyboard user can always reach them before the timer resumes.

parts.note: the live region: a stack anchored to one viewport edge, sized by size-overlay-sm, sitting on layer-notification
one notification — its internal parts (icon, title, description, action-slot, close) and its tone axis are anatomy/toast.json, which is normative; repeated here only as the region's repeating child

anatomyNotes: Sonner is the toaster REGION; anatomy/toast.json is the item. Keeping them separate is what lets the live-region behavior (announce, pause-on-hover, stacking order, edge anchoring) be contracted independently of a toast's own tone axis and parts. Salt ships no toaster region at all — its Toast is composed by hand into a StackLayout — so the region behavior is adopted from APG and the WAI-ARIA live-region spec, and the shadcn item's dependency on the `sonner` package is an implementation of this anatomy, not the anatomy itself. The edge axis names the viewport edge the stack anchors to; inline alignment within a top/bottom edge is a recipe detail, and new toasts always enter at the anchored edge so the stack grows away from it.
